sentences.sentence: The Widow Douglas is a kind and caring person.
Huck's pa is neither friendly nor kind.
Jim wants freedom, so he is trying to escape to the North.
The Widow Douglas tries to help Huck because she is a nice person.
Huck doesn't want to live with his pa, but his pa kidnaps him.
The Widow Douglas gives Huck an education even though he doesn't like school.
Huck's pa will be gone by the end of the story.
The Widow Douglas is important because she changes Huck's life.
